definitions.gloss: early, ahead of time, on the early side
definitions.explanation: Earlier than usual or expected; with time to spare. Used to indicate doing something before the deadline or expected time.

examples.japanese: {早|はや}めに⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦しましょう→する：00392_suru⟧。
{早|はや}めに⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: You should make a reservation early.

examples.japanese: {早|はや}めに⟦{寝|ね}て→寝る：00470_neru⟧、⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{治|なお}そう→治す：19371_naosu⟧。
examples.english: Let's go to bed early and cure this cold.

notes:
FORMATION: ⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ (early) + め (somewhat, -ish) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverb marker)

The 〜め pattern indicates 'on the ~ side' or 'somewhat ~':
- ⟦{大|おお}きめ→大きめ：21239_ookime⟧ (on the large side)
- ⟦{小|ちい}さめ→小さめ：21795_chiisame⟧ (on the small side)
- ⟦{遅|おそ}め→遅め：27979_osome⟧ (on the late side)

NUANCE: {早|はや}めに suggests being prudently early or giving oneself extra time, rather than extremely early.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早|はや}めに⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧/⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (leave early)
- {早|はや}めに⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (book early)
- {早|はや}めに⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ (go to bed early)
- {早|はや}めに⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (prepare early)
